failure_summary.description: Selected an unsupported refinement—such as extra geometric, multiplicative, quantitative, or regularity conclusions—because it sounded stronger.
Invented a specialized equivalence between a complexity bound and a structural condition instead of verifying the exact theorem.

patch.reasoning: The skill already warns against unproved upgrades, but the trajectories show that warning is not being applied systematically when options add clauses or present specialized equivalences. An explicit option-audit procedure can make the agent verify each added claim before ranking choices.

edits.content:
### Audit each option before ranking
Rewrite each choice as its core claim plus every added clause, and verify each clause independently under the stated hypotheses. A basic existence or per-parameter result does not by itself establish uniqueness, global scope, endpoint or maximal regularity, special geometric containment/construction, fiber or codimension properties, or compatibility of choices across degrees. Likewise, do not infer a specialized equivalence from analogy: use the exact theorem or a derivation. Rank only options whose full claims are established; stronger wording is not evidence.
